demo.cliff: a crew roster resolves through a role Item
teaches: crewRole is the station this role fills, chosen from a closed list, and it is what the ship's code looks a station up by.
actions[] is the row of things this station may do in a combat round: a label, what kind of thing it is, the check it takes, and which step of the round it belongs to.
positions is how many people the station seats, salary what one of them is paid, and colour what the deck plan tints them.
demo.trap: The ship's roster stores the id of this Item, never its name. And the code finds the pilot by the derived crewRoleKey rather than by anything stored here — write crewRoleKey into a role by hand and it is dropped with no message, because the schema has no such field.

system.description: Flies the ship. On a courier that is one person, and the same person as the captain more often than not.
